falsifier: If TrendForce's 4Q26 conventional-DRAM contract forecast comes in at or above the 3Q26 +13-18% QoQ pace (sequential rate stops decelerating) AND NVDA's Q3 print does not confirm the guided step-down to ~74% gross margin, both the second-derivative and margin-peak legs fail and this moves back to `mid`. priced_in_read: LESS per unit of capex growth than 3m ago. Suppliers are de-rating on accelerating fundamentals: MRVL beat and guided ~4% above consensus, -10.28%; COHR beat rev+EPS with raised FY27 outlook, fell; NVDA beat +6.16% EPS with -5.3% 2d drift; SMH -3.47% on 08-28 while AMZN +3.97%, MSFT +1.68%, GOOG +1.53%. Capital is paying up for the investment-grade balance sheets buying the capex and marking down the levered suppliers selling it. This is a de-rating market, not a fully-priced one.
